title: Responsive React navigation
summary: Swipe between adjacent tabs and use a faster, accessible navigation component after sign-in.
changes: The signed-in tab bar is a reusable React and TypeScript component that loads after authorization, with the existing HTML controls kept as a fallback.
A short touch swipe across the tab bar navigates to the adjacent view, and Motion gives taps restrained feedback with reduced-motion support.
Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat retain their badges and existing data flows; Tailwind CSS v4 stays scoped and light and dark chrome and safe PWA updates remain compatible.
